import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import numpy as np

with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)["energy_sankey"]

nodes = data["nodes"]
flows = data["flows"]

node_map = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
node_ids = [n["id"] for n in nodes]

# Compute totals for each node
in_total = {nid: 0.0 for nid in node_ids}
out_total = {nid: 0.0 for nid in node_ids}
for f in flows:
    out_total[f["source"]] += f["value"]
    in_total[f["target"]] += f["value"]

node_size = {}
for n in nodes:
    nid = n["id"]
    node_size[nid] = max(in_total[nid], out_total[nid])

# Layout parameters
fig_w, fig_h = 22, 12
col_x = {0: 1.5, 1: 9.0, 2: 16.5}
node_w = 0.4
gap = 0.3
scale = 0.045  # EJ to figure units

primary_order = ["oil", "coal", "natural_gas", "nuclear", "hydro", "wind", "solar", "biomass", "geothermal"]
transform_order = ["thermal_power", "refining", "direct_use", "electricity_grid"]
enduse_order = ["transport", "industry", "buildings", "agriculture", "other", "waste_heat"]

stages = [
    (0, primary_order),
    (1, transform_order),
    (2, enduse_order),
]

node_colors = {
    "oil": "#2c2c2c",
    "coal": "#4a4a4a",
    "natural_gas": "#5a5a70",
    "nuclear": "#9060b0",
    "hydro": "#1e78b4",
    "wind": "#46b4dc",
    "solar": "#e8c820",
    "biomass": "#50a03c",
    "geothermal": "#b45028",
    "thermal_power": "#8c4646",
    "refining": "#5a4640",
    "direct_use": "#787850",
    "electricity_grid": "#3264a0",
    "transport": "#3c3c8c",
    "industry": "#648240",
    "buildings": "#a0783c",
    "agriculture": "#3c8c50",
    "other": "#828282",
    "waste_heat": "#dc3c1e",
}

# Compute y positions for each node
node_pos = {}  # nid -> (x, y_top)
for col, order in stages:
    total_h = sum(node_size[nid] * scale for nid in order) + gap * (len(order) - 1)
    y_start = (fig_h - total_h) / 2 + total_h  # start from top
    y = y_start
    for nid in order:
        h = node_size[nid] * scale
        node_pos[nid] = (col_x[col], y)
        y -= h + gap

# Track how much of each node side is used
node_out_used = {nid: 0.0 for nid in node_ids}  # right side offset from top
node_in_used = {nid: 0.0 for nid in node_ids}   # left side offset from top

def draw_flow_band(ax, x0, y0_top, x1, y1_top, band_h, color):
    """Draw a curved band from right side of source to left side of target."""
    x0r = x0 + node_w
    x1l = x1
    mid = (x0r + x1l) / 2

    verts = [
        (x0r, y0_top),
        (mid, y0_top),
        (mid, y1_top),
        (x1l, y1_top),
        (x1l, y1_top - band_h),
        (mid, y1_top - band_h),
        (mid, y0_top - band_h),
        (x0r, y0_top - band_h),
        (x0r, y0_top),
    ]
    codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4,
             Path.LINETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CLOSEPOLY]

    path = Path(verts, codes)
    patch = mpatches.PathPatch(path, facecolor=color, edgecolor="none", lw=0, alpha=0.55, zorder=1)
    ax.add_patch(patch)

# Flow ordering: process flows in the order of source/target node ordering
fossil_ids = {"oil", "coal", "natural_gas"}
renewable_ids = {"hydro", "wind", "solar", "biomass", "geothermal"}

# Sort flows for consistent layout
def flow_sort_key(f):
    s_stage = node_map[f["source"]]["stage"]
    t_stage = node_map[f["target"]]["stage"]
    all_orders = primary_order + transform_order + enduse_order
    return (all_orders.index(f["source"]), all_orders.index(f["target"]))

sorted_flows = sorted(flows, key=flow_sort_key)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(fig_w, fig_h))
ax.set_xlim(0, fig_w + 2)
ax.set_ylim(0, fig_h)
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.axis("off")
fig.patch.set_facecolor("white")

# Draw flows
for f in sorted_flows:
    src, tgt, val = f["source"], f["target"], f["value"]
    band_h = val * scale

    sx, sy_top = node_pos[src]
    y0 = sy_top - node_out_used[src]
    node_out_used[src] += band_h

    tx, ty_top = node_pos[tgt]
    y1 = ty_top - node_in_used[tgt]
    node_in_used[tgt] += band_h

    if tgt == "waste_heat":
        color = "#dc5030"
    elif src in fossil_ids:
        color = "#666666"
    elif src in renewable_ids:
        color = "#40a070"
    elif src == "nuclear":
        color = "#9070b0"
    else:
        color = node_colors.get(src, "#aaaaaa")

    draw_flow_band(ax, sx, y0, tx, y1, band_h, color)

# Draw nodes
for nid in node_ids:
    x, y_top = node_pos[nid]
    h = node_size[nid] * scale
    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch((x, y_top - h), node_w, h,
                                     boxstyle="round,pad=0.02",
                                     facecolor=node_colors[nid],
                                     edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.8, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    label = node_map[nid]["label"]
    val = node_size[nid]
    stage = node_map[nid]["stage"]

    fontsize = 8.5 if val < 15 else 9.5

    if stage == "primary":
        ax.text(x - 0.15, y_top - h/2, f"{label}\n{val:.1f} EJ",
                ha="right", va="center", fontsize=fontsize, fontweight="bold",
                color=node_colors[nid], zorder=4)
    elif stage == "end_use":
        ax.text(x + node_w + 0.15, y_top - h/2, f"{label}\n{val:.1f} EJ",
                ha="left", va="center", fontsize=fontsize, fontweight="bold",
                color=node_colors[nid], zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(x + node_w/2, y_top + 0.15, f"{label}\n{val:.1f} EJ",
                ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=fontsize, fontweight="bold",
                color=node_colors[nid], zorder=4)

# Title
ax.text(fig_w/2 + 1, fig_h - 0.3, "Global Energy Flow — 2022 Approximate Balance",
        ha="center", va="top", fontsize=18, fontweight="bold", color="#1a1a1a")
ax.text(fig_w/2 + 1, fig_h - 0.8, "Primary Sources → Transformation → End-Use Sectors  |  All flows in Exajoules (EJ)",
        ha="center", va="top", fontsize=11, color="#555555")

# Column headers
ax.text(col_x[0] + node_w/2, fig_h - 1.3, "PRIMARY SOURCES", ha="center", fontsize=10,
        fontweight="bold", color="#888888")
ax.text(col_x[1] + node_w/2, fig_h - 1.3, "TRANSFORMATION", ha="center", fontsize=10,
        fontweight="bold", color="#888888")
ax.text(col_x[2] + node_w/2, fig_h - 1.3, "END-USE SECTORS", ha="center", fontsize=10,
        fontweight="bold", color="#888888")

# Legend
legend_items = [
    ("Fossil Fuels", "#666666"),
    ("Nuclear", "#9070b0"),
    ("Renewables", "#40a070"),
    ("Waste / Rejected Heat", "#dc5030"),
]
for i, (lbl, clr) in enumerate(legend_items):
    lx = 1.0 + i * 4.0
    ly = 0.4
    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch((lx, ly - 0.12), 0.5, 0.24,
                                     boxstyle="round,pad=0.02",
